pages.title: About Us
pages.page_body:
Since 2012 The Saffron Table has served hand-crafted North Indian and continental dishes made with farm-fresh ingredients, in a cosy space made for long conversations.

Our story

The Saffron Table started with a simple idea: slow-cooked flavours, warm hospitality. Today a passionate team carries that promise forward every day.

What we believe

  • People first
  • Quality without shortcuts
  • Honest, transparent communication

pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.page_body:
The Saffron Table respects your privacy. We collect only the information you share with us through our forms, use it only to respond to you, and never sell it.

Contact us anytime to view or delete your data.

pages.title: Terms of Use
pages.page_body: By using the The Saffron Table website you agree to use it lawfully. Content is for general information and may change without notice.

blogs.title: The secret behind our butter chicken
blogs.author: Chef Arjun
blogs.summary: It starts with a 24-hour marinade and ends in a tandoor kissed with charcoal.
blogs.body:
It starts with a 24-hour marinade and ends in a tandoor kissed with charcoal.

We smoke the chicken over charcoal, then finish it in a gravy made from slow-roasted tomatoes and cultured butter.
